state_notes.clean: Every drain at its surveyed size, no silt. Rain is a synthetic, spatially uniform storm and hydraulic parameters are uncalibrated.
state_notes.silted: Identical-twin truth: silt planted in the model at 70% of drain depth along 4 GCC drains: Lake View Road (GCC OBJECTID 7390), Padmanaba Nagar Main Road (GCC OBJECTID 6999), Vandikaaran Road (GCC OBJECTID 7416), 100 Feet Road LHS (GCC OBJECTID 6423). A test case, not a field finding.
state_notes.inferred: Silt estimated by the model from 30 simulated street gauges (depth every 10 min for 3 h, 2 cm noise) in the 60 mm twin storm, over 17 candidate drains. This run ranked 2 of the 4 planted drains in its top 4 and flagged 2 drains with silt over 35% (2 correct). Identical-twin test, not a field finding.

edge_depth: street water depth on a segment = the larger of its two end-junction street depths
rain_note: Synthetic storm, spatially uniform over the site, bell-shaped in time with its peak at minute 60. rain_mm_h_10min is the mean rate over the 10 minutes before each frame.
